captions.detailed: A telescoping street bollard consisting of a dark grey square outer sleeve designed to be fixed underground, a protruding inner square post that extends vertically, and a light grey domed cap plate. The cap plate covers the top of the assembly when the inner post is fully retracted. The inner post moves along a vertical prismatic joint, while the cap plate is mounted on a revolute hinge at the top of the inner post.
captions.instruction: Generate a telescoping street bollard with a dark grey square outer sleeve and a vertically extending inner square post. Add a light grey domed cap plate at the top of the inner post using a revolute joint, and connect the inner post to the outer sleeve with a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: Create three parts: an outer sleeve, an inner post, and a top cap. Define the outer sleeve by combining a hollowed vertical box with a top flange plate. Model the inner post as a smaller square box that fits inside the sleeve. Model the cap as a thin plate with a domed top. Define a prismatic joint between the outer sleeve and the inner post along the Z-axis, and a revolute joint between the inner post and the cap at the top edge.
